status: Production cinematic contract updated for approved November12 Sean rain redesign; asset/runtime revision and native acceptance pending.
authorization: Sean requested completion of both starter activation animations with Art and Mechanics, followed by Engineering handoff for his playtest.
timing_decision: Art and Mechanics selected Tony 3.2 seconds and Sean 3.4 seconds for every accepted activation. Production targets within Sean's requested 3–4 seconds; not individually measured durations from reference games.

scope.balance_exception: Sean rain redesign specified in design/starter-specials-v1/mechanics.json; no Tony balance or charge-count changes.

balance_invariants.boss_gates: Preserve the current integrated boss vulnerability rules, including current Clogfather enrage behavior. Do not restore obsolete recovery-only assumptions.

sean_effect_clock.clock_domain: Gameplay rain time since cinematic handoff
sean_effect_clock.pose_state: Fully emerged pipe at rain clock0; no plant/pull replay or old first-second root.

balance_invariants.clock_rule: Explicit Sean clarification: cinematic time consumes none of the7.5s actual rain. Start rain clock0 after3.4s presentation; first damage after one full gameplay second. Tony retains its unchanged7.5s after handoff.
balance_invariants.tick_handoff: No damage during cinematic. Sean starts rain clock0, pulses1..7, ends7.5; no immediate or fractional-final tick. Tony first tick remains0.1.
balance_invariants.stock: Accept and spend exactly once before presentation. Empty or otherwise invalid requests neither spend nor animate. No refund for death, retry, cancellation or scene teardown. No second spend at handoff.
balance_invariants.shared_damage_scope: These three legacy fields describe Tony only; Sean explicit overrides below.

world_freeze: active gameplay VFX and existing spent-prop animation
shared_presentation.pause: Pause/menu/focus-loss pauses cinematic and cinematic audio at their current offsets. Resume the same offsets without replaying cues. Do not clear another system's freeze when the cinematic ends.
shared_presentation.world_state: Keep positions, velocities, HP, boss phase, projectile trajectories and gameplay camera baseline unchanged while presenting. Cinematic shake changes render offsets only, never collision geometry.
shared_presentation.animation: Opaque authored character poses with registered in-betweens; no dissolves between incompatible body/tool poses. Start with roughly 12–15 unique poses per second for broad motion and additional contact/slam poses where needed. These are asset-budget targets, not a fixed playback-rate requirement. Use variable frame durations driven by elapsed seconds.
shared_presentation.interpolation: Smoothly interpolate camera, gauge needle/dial and overlay fades at render rate. Preserve planted feet, cup and hand/tool registration. Do not interpolate body silhouettes by alpha blending or stretch a static hero to imitate effort.

camera.framing: Reduce zoom and clamp translation as needed to keep Sean's head, overhead plunger, both feet, cup/socket and emerging pipe inside safe rect. No camera overshoot or out-of-world exposure. Exact zoom is subordinate to framing.
camera.curve: Smooth ease-in/out with zero endpoint velocity; restore exact baseline before returning control.
camera.tony: Keep world camera fixed under the gauge overlay.

shared_presentation.audio_mix: Keep music continuous with Audio's proposed 4 dB duck, combining with other duck owners using the minimum gain rather than additive attenuation. Pause/fade world action loops so frozen enemies do not continue moving audibly. Restore prior mix ownership once on handoff/cancel; never overwrite user mute or volume. No extra full-screen flash.
shared_presentation.control_return: After reveal/camera restoration, use current held movement, aim and ordinary fire. Discard action edges accumulated during the movie; a second special requires release and fresh press. No new jump buffering feature in this delivery. Activation button never acts as skip or triggers two uses.
shared_presentation.interruptions: Reject activation when already dead, in dialogue, blocked cinematic/ride/flush state, or otherwise disallowed by current rules. Preserve Sean's supported-ground and pipe-clearance eligibility. Tony may retain his existing airborne eligibility: freeze and restore velocity rather than teleport to ground. Restart/title/scene teardown clears cinematic, audio, camera overrides and pending handoff. Forced cancellation never launches delayed damage.
shared_presentation.completion: Restore baseline camera and remove occluding overlay before the same atomic handoff that resumes world simulation and starts the effect. No hidden recovery delay and no extra invulnerability grant.

beats.action: Freeze immediately; fade gauge assembly in with needle at one-third pressure.
Hold starting pressure long enough to read the mechanical setup.
Separate dial turns clockwise through one full turn. Needle follows pressure rise from one-third through red to the physical maximum.
One full second of unit-local tremble; needle pinned at maximum, not a second loading hold. Keep dial attached and readable.
Fade assembly away. Final pressure-release hiss connects to the actual weapon nozzle. Resume with Hydrojet Overdrive at elapsed zero.

assets: opaque gauge face/backplate with pressure markings
separate transparent needle with exact pivot and calibrated start/max angles
separate clockwise dial/crank with pivot and attachment
optional registered casing details for tremble
tony.coverage: Gauge assembly shared across all three costumes and both facings; keep markings upright, never mirror text. Underlying gameplay Tony retains selected costume. No extra Tony portrait/full-body sprite is required for this gauge-only cinematic.
tony.manifest: Art supplies source rectangles, native destination bounds, layer order, needle/dial pivots, rotational clearance, calibrated arc endpoints and color-independent pressure markings. Do not assume art arc spans a particular angle.

beats.action: Freeze; draw plunger while camera eases toward Sean without moving his feet.
Raise plunger overhead; keep tool, hands and head fully framed.
Accelerating downward swing into the fixed floor socket.
80 ms contact-pose hold with short decaying render-only shake; cup stays planted.
First effort: knees/hips load, shoulders rise, hands pull against sealed cup; eyes close and teeth grit at peak, then partial recoil.
Second stronger distinct effort with the same fixed cup/socket and readable facial strain.
Seal gives way; tool and hands follow the release with controlled recoil.

Huge pipe rises at fixed socket while camera restores framing. Once plunger clears outlet, huge geyser fires straight UP during cinematic. At3.4 restore gameplay and replace eruption with viewport-wide rain. Visual eruption causes no damage.

registration.capture_rule: Capture facing, feet, supported floor and socket once on accepted activation. Camera changes never rebase them. Left-facing geometry mirrors X about feet/socket consistently.
registration.source_dimensions_status: Working envelope for Art, not a runtime hard-coded scale. Art may revise with explicit measured native destinations and anchors; match current costume body size at ordinary camera scale.
registration.costumes: Complete Normal/Easy/Hard sets with consistent feet/tool/socket anchors. Preserve each existing costume design and Sean's identity; no surnames or new outfit interpretation.
registration.pose_handoff: Keep registered feet/socket and selected costume continuity. Final cinematic pipe remains fully emerged/upright; start separate rain clock0 without replaying preparation or rooting the hero. Art owns new geyser/rain dimensions; no horizontal sweep.

impact_shake.rule: Short decaying translation only; never shake collision bodies or introduce camera roll.

eruption_handoff.rule: Use final cleared-tool/recovery poses before visual geyser; never emit through cup.3.2 onset is a candidate reuse point, not a separate user-approved duration. Art/Engineering may retime within existing final reveal without changing3.4duration or rain clock.

tony.audio_note: No additional new transient required; Audio maps the existing water onset at handoff.

sean.audio_note: Candidate sync after tool clears; Audio reviews onset/transition, no extra gameplay delay.

audio_events.handoff_rule: Tony audio unchanged. Sean preparation cues stay synchronized; vertical cinematic geyser transitions to rain at3.4. No late old seal/pull/break replay or post-handoff hinge/tilt cue. Rain sustain/tail ends with7.5s post-cinematic rain lifetime; Audio updates mapping/auditions and preserves original sources.
audio_events.hitch_rule: Seek current presentation state without replaying all expired one-shots in a burst; dispatch each event at most once. Pause preserves offsets; cancellation stops voices and restores prior mix.
audio_events.sean_tail: Previous bent-jet sustain/hinge/tail mapping is superseded for Sean. Audio owns rain transition/sustain/fade mapping; stop at expiry/cancel with no delayed rain damage or charge changes.

required_tests: Accepted fresh press spends once; rejected, empty, airborne Sean and invalid clearance requests do not spend or animate.
Both heroes and all costumes, both facings, 30/60/120 Hz and variable/large frame steps reach exact production boundaries without duplicate cues or handoff.
Freeze positions, velocities, projectile paths, boss/encounter timers, HP and invulnerability timers throughout; no catch-up damage on resume.
Pause/focus-loss at every beat preserves timeline/audio; restart/title/scene exit cancels and clears render overrides without charge refund or delayed activation.
Held special never spends twice; current held aim/movement/fire resume immediately; stale button edges do not leak.
First/last camera transforms match baseline; floor/socket/grip anchors remain stable at edges, raised platforms, narrow clearance, both directions and all costumes.

Native960x540 running capture plus continuous-motion review: body proportions, overhead clearance, eye/teeth readability, gauge start/red/max readability, tool contact, causal pipe/nozzle handoff and no opacity body ghosts.
Independent Art review, Audio mix review, then Engineering integration/build checks and Sean playtest. Research/contract completion alone is not runtime or visual acceptance.
Tony preserves74 ideal ticks at24regular/12boss; Sean rain delivers seven37.5pulses at gameplay+1..+7seconds over7.5seconds, with no immediate handoff damage.
Sean has one emergence, one visual-only upright cinematic geyser and one rain onset; cup cleared before eruption. No former tilt/horizontal attack or duplicated onset.

research.evidence_limit: No reference-game activation was frame-timed in this research. Numerical beat lengths, pose budgets, zoom and mix values are production proposals. Sources support design principles rather than a universal duration standard. Full source video playback was not audited; official descriptions/indexed primary slide text were used where full fetch was unavailable.
